title: Closing and coupling: metal linked biliazine dimers
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,24747-24751
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01668E, Paper

Towhidi Illius Jeaydi, Wei-Yuan Chen, Michael D. Tedesco, Briana R. Schrage, Victor N. Nemykin, Christopher J. Ziegler
The self-assembly of four equivalents of azole-modified diiminoisoindolines with three equivalents of zinc ion produces zinc-linked biliazine dimers, where the bridging zinc ion completes the phthalocyanine-analogue rings.
